lastReleaseMessage: Units get health bars, and a Health bars setting that governs every bar in the game. hp_bar.tscn is an authored ProgressBar instanced by every unit scene including the Spine-driven Rifleman, shown only while damaged by default on the same colour ramp buildings use, seated to clear the tallest unit and at z 100 so a unit in front cannot cover the bar behind. options.health_bar_mode adds Always visible and Off, wired into Settings General and applied live to units and buildings. Verified in a running build across all three modes; 630 tests, ratchet green.

items: M1 gameplay vertical slice not yet assembled: Hold the Wall 5-7 wave mission script (bk-mission-hold, P1), Lantern Oil drain + mission-fail clock UI, Shambler + Lunger combat tuning, and Hatchery destruction + Coral Receding VFX are all still pending per the GDD Roadmap tab (docs/GDD.html)
Wood Wall / Gate / Tower cell-occupant refactor (v0.14.0) and build-menu category-tab polish still pending

MVP art + audio integration ongoing and paced by Navy's delivery cadence: HUD rebuild, Spine2D rigs, and the terrain TileMapLayer migration landed through the v0.59.x series, but remaining unit/building art and MVP-scope audio are still outstanding

Basis for the 50% hold: the art-integration track has been the active work for weeks while the six gameplay slice deliverables above are unstarted; number is evidence-anchored here, not moved, and will only advance when a real gameplay deliverable lands

barRaise.topFinding: The nightly audit fired, found the most serious drift it has found in weeks, and the dashboard never heard about it. docs/CANONICAL_AUDIT-2026-07-26.md landed at 01:35 with two HIGH findings (the Numbers tab documents a per-second Sonic Pressure decay ledger that economy.gd:381 sets to 0.0, and the SP reduction table names three Keepers absent from the 80-card catalog in the same document), the drift pass applied 20 GDD edits, and both committed as d2e4867. Rising.json audit still reads latestReportPath docs/CANONICAL_AUDIT-2026-07-25.md with findings 0/0/0 at a 2026-07-25 timestamp, and that path no longer resolves because retention deleted the 07-25 report. Chains.json and Apothecary.json both advanced to 2026-07-26 this morning, so the last mile of the audit loop is broken for BR specifically; the four audit findings did reach the work queue, so only the dashboard write failed. Everything else in the window is strong: v0.59.48 landed a stranded doc pass with two of its own claims corrected rather than published, v0.59.49 put units on an authored hp_bar.tscn with a live Settings toggle and 630 tests without moving a single ratchet counter, the tree is clean for the first time in three runs, and all five preship gates match baseline exactly. Health is flat at 83 (unrounded 83.5 to 83.4). Both hard rules pass, no BLOCK.
